name: Studio Idol
source:
Main character gets fired from the entertainment production and finds a job as a manager in a rival  company where idol body training is considered the main element of success.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角被娱乐制作公司解雇，并在一家竞争对手公司找到了一份经理的工作，在该公司，偶像的身体训练被认为是成功的主要因素。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
